description:
Want to become an AI DevOps Engineer in 2026?
In this video, I explain the simple roadmap to start a career in AI DevOps.

First, you need to learn DevOps fundamentals like Linux, Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. These tools help teams automate software delivery and manage deployments.

Next, understand Cloud platforms like AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. Most modern applications run on the cloud, and DevOps engineers manage these systems.

Finally, learn automation and AI-driven DevOps tools like Terraform, Kubernetes, and GitHub Copilot. These tools help engineers automate infrastructure and use AI to improve workflows.

The future DevOps engineer doesn’t just deploy code — they deploy intelligent systems powered by AI.

If you want to work in high-paying tech roles, this roadmap will help you get started.
